description: docs/backlog/CLEANUP_MODE.md's Cleanup Assessment rules — VL-CC-PAYMENT-001, VL-PAYROLL-LUMP-001, VL-DUP-VEND-001, VL-DUP-BILL-001. Verifies each against real sandbox data before shipping.

purchases.case: VL-CC-PAYMENT-001 — credit card payment coded to an expense account instead of the card's own liability account. Vendor name 'VL Spike Amex' exactly matches a real Credit Card-type account of the same name, so this should match at .high confidence.
VL-PAYROLL-LUMP-001 — payroll processor payment coded to a single expense line instead of split wages/tax/withholding.
VL-DUP-EXP-002 — same vendor/amount/near-date, paid from Checking. Cross-account duplicate candidate A.
VL-DUP-EXP-002 — same vendor/amount, paid from the Amex credit card two days later instead of Checking. Cross-account duplicate candidate B.

VL-CAT-UNCAT-001 — a bank-feed item added without picking a real category, still sitting in QBO's default Uncategorized Expense catch-all account. Vendor is deliberately NOT 'VL Spike Amex' — that name would trip VL-CC-PAYMENT-001's relationship gate first and exclude this transaction from categorization-class rules via §8.2a.
